title: ISMA and ICAR-ISRI Sign MoU for Sugarcane Seed Centre
summary: The Indian Sugar & Bio-Energy Manufacturers Association (ISMA) and the ICAR-Indian Sugarcane Research Institute (ICAR-ISRI) signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) on 13 August 2026 to set up an Advanced Centre for Quality Sugarcane ...

blocks.content: The Indian Sugar & Bio-Energy Manufacturers Association (ISMA) and the ICAR-Indian Sugarcane Research Institute (ICAR-ISRI) signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) on 13 August 2026 to set up an Advanced Centre for Quality Sugarcane Seed Production. The centre will come up at the ICAR-ISRI campus in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, and will serve sugar mills in the subtropical region.

items: Sugarcane is a major commercial crop in India and is used for sugar, jaggery, molasses, and bio-energy applications.
Seed cane quality affects germination, disease spread, and crop productivity in sugarcane cultivation.
Disease indexing is a laboratory and field method used to detect plant pathogens in seed material.
Digital traceability systems are used in agriculture to track the origin, movement, and quality of farm inputs.
